titles.title: Youngster
intro_dialogue: Hey! I just caught my first animal! Let's battle!
I'm gonna be the best trainer ever! Watch me!
My animals are the coolest! You ready?
My dad says I need more practice... but I'll show him!
I've been waiting in this grass all day for a challenger!
mid_battle_dialogue: No way! My animal can't lose!
Come on, buddy! You can do it!
This isn't over yet!
I trained really hard for this!
Wait till you see my next one!
defeat_dialogue: Aww man... I lost again.
My animals need more training I guess...
You're really strong! I'll get better though!

titles.title: Black Belt
intro_dialogue: HAAAA! My fighting spirit burns bright! Let's go!
I've trained my body AND my animals to perfection!
Strength comes from discipline! I'll show you mine!
My animals fight with the fury of a thousand storms!
You dare challenge me? Then face my wrath!
mid_battle_dialogue: The fight isn't over until the last one falls!
Concentrate! Find the opening!
Feel the power of my training!
My spirit is unbreakable!
HYAAAH! Next animal, GO!
defeat_dialogue: Your strength... it surpasses my own. Well fought.
I must train harder. You've humbled me.
Impressive technique! I bow to your skill.

titles.title: Gentleman
intro_dialogue: Ah, a challenger! How delightful. Shall we?
I trust you'll provide a sophisticated battle, hmm?
My dear friend, let us engage in a proper duel!
One must always be prepared for a good battle, no?
Do pardon me, but I simply must test your mettle!
mid_battle_dialogue: Quite impressive, I must say!
Oh my! This is getting rather exciting!
A splendid exchange! But I'm not done yet.
My next companion shall turn this around, I assure you.
How invigorating! Come now, let's continue!
defeat_dialogue: Bravo! A most excellent performance!
Well played indeed! Here, take this as a token of my respect.
You've bested me fair and square. Good show!

titles.title: Hiker
intro_dialogue: GAHAHA! You came all the way out here? Let's battle!
The mountains make animals tough! Mine are no exception!
I've been hiking these trails for years! My animals are hardy!
Whew! Nice weather for a battle, don'tcha think?
Hold on, let me catch my breath... Okay, I'm ready!
mid_battle_dialogue: My animals are as sturdy as the mountains themselves!
You can't shake us! We're built tough!
GAHAHA! This is fun!
My next partner is even tougher!
We've weathered worse storms than this!
defeat_dialogue: GAHAHA! You knocked me flat! Good battle!
Well, time to hike back and train some more!
The mountain will make us stronger. Until next time!

titles.title: Bug Catcher
intro_dialogue: Check out the awesome bugs I caught! Let's battle!
Insects are the most diverse creatures on Earth! I'll prove it!
I spent all morning catching these beauties!
Don't underestimate bugs! They're incredible!
My net's my best friend, and my bugs are my warriors!
mid_battle_dialogue: Bugs never give up! Just like me!
Wait till you see this one's moves!
My collection is vast! There's always more!
Every bug has a unique strength!
The swarm continues!
defeat_dialogue: My bugs... I need to find stronger ones!
Back to the tall grass to catch more!
You're tough, but I'll be back with an even better collection!

titles.title: Fisherman
intro_dialogue: I've been fishing here all day! How about a battle?
You should see the size of the one I caught yesterday!
My aquatic partners are fierce! Don't get soaked!
The water holds many secrets... and strong animals!
Patience is key in fishing AND in battle!
mid_battle_dialogue: My fish aren't just for show!
Hook, line, and sinker!
The water runs deep, and so does my team!
Reel 'em in, partner!
There's plenty more fish in the sea!
defeat_dialogue: Looks like you reeled in the victory!
Back to the fishing hole for me...
That was a real catch of a battle!

titles.title: Scientist
intro_dialogue: Fascinating! A wild trainer appears! Let me collect data!
I hypothesize that my animals are superior. Let's test that!
My research demands combat data! Battle me!
Every battle is an experiment in progress!
The scientific method: Observe, hypothesize, BATTLE!
mid_battle_dialogue: Interesting data point! But the experiment continues!
Recalculating strategy parameters...
My next subject should prove more effective!
The results so far are... inconclusive!
Adjusting variables for optimal performance!
defeat_dialogue: The data doesn't lie... you're the stronger trainer.
I need to revise my methodology entirely!
A failed experiment is still a learning opportunity!

titles.title: Sailor
intro_dialogue: Ahoy! Ye want a battle? I'll show ye sea-worthy power!
These waters be treacherous, and so are my animals!
I've sailed the seven seas! My crew is battle-hardened!
Batten down the hatches! A storm of a battle approaches!
Arr! Ye look like a worthy adversary!
mid_battle_dialogue: Shiver me timbers! That was a good hit!
The sea is rough, but my crew's rougher!
All hands on deck! Next animal, report!
Ye can't sink this ship that easily!
Man overboard! But the fleet continues!
defeat_dialogue: Ye've sunk my battleship! Well fought, matey!
I'll sail back stronger next time!
A captain goes down with his ship... Fair play!

titles.title: Ace Trainer
intro_dialogue: I've trained every day for this moment. Let's go!
You think you can beat an Ace Trainer? Prove it!
My strategy is flawless. Show me yours!
Only the strongest trainers earn this title. Can you keep up?
I've studied every type matchup. Bring your best!
mid_battle_dialogue: Just as I calculated!
You're good, but I'm better!
Phase two of my strategy begins now!
That's the spirit! Now face my ace!
Impressive... but I won't go down easily!
defeat_dialogue: You've earned my respect. That was a true battle!
I'll remember this loss and grow from it.
An Ace knows when they've been outplayed. Well done!

titles.title: Psychic
intro_dialogue: I foresaw your arrival... and your defeat!
My third eye reveals all! Let's battle!
The mind is the greatest weapon. Observe!
I sense strong energy from you... This will be interesting!
Close your eyes... and prepare to lose!
mid_battle_dialogue: The visions told me to expect this...
My psychic bond with my animals is unbreakable!
I predicted this move! Now face the counter!
The cosmic forces align in my favor!
Your mind is an open book to me!
defeat_dialogue: I... didn't foresee this outcome.
The universe works in mysterious ways...
Your willpower overwhelms my visions!

titles.title: Veteran
intro_dialogue: I've fought in countless battles. One more won't hurt!
Experience is the greatest teacher. Let me show you!
I've been battling since before you were born, kid!
A true veteran never backs down from a challenge!
My years of experience give me the edge. Ready?
mid_battle_dialogue: I've seen worse! This is nothing!
Old soldiers never die... and neither do my animals!
Strategy wins wars, not brute force!
My tactical reserve enters the fray!
You fight well, but I've got tricks up my sleeve!
defeat_dialogue: I salute you, soldier. You've won this battle.
Even veterans can learn new things. Thank you!
A well-deserved victory. Carry on, champion!

titles.title: Ranger
intro_dialogue: Halt! Rangers protect these lands! Show your strength!
The wild has made my animals fierce! Can you handle them?
I patrol these routes daily. No one passes without a battle!
Nature gives us power! Let me show you!
My bond with my animals is forged in the wild!
mid_battle_dialogue: The wild calls for reinforcements!
Nature always finds a way!
My partner won't let me down!
Rangers never give up!
The forest has more surprises in store!
defeat_dialogue: You've proven your worth. Pass freely!
The wild respects strength. Well fought!
I'll report your skills to headquarters!

titles.title: Lass
intro_dialogue: Hey there! I've been looking for someone to battle!
My animals are super cute AND super strong!
Don't go easy on me just because I'm a girl!
I've raised my animals with love! They won't lose!
Let's have a fun battle! Ready?
mid_battle_dialogue: That was a lucky hit! My next one is tougher!
Come on, sweetie! You can do it!
We're not giving up that easily!
My cutest animal is also my strongest!
Here comes my secret weapon!
defeat_dialogue: Oh no! I lost... That was still fun though!
You're really good! Let's battle again sometime!
My animals did their best. I'm proud of them!

titles.title: Beauty
intro_dialogue: Oh my! A battle? How thrilling! Let me fix my hair first...
Beauty AND skill! I have both, darling!
My animals are as gorgeous as they are powerful!
A lady must always be prepared for battle!
Shall we make this interesting? Battle me, won't you?
mid_battle_dialogue: Oh my! That was rather rough!
Beauty fades, but strength endures!
My next darling will dazzle you!
A lady never shows all her cards at once!
How graceful! But can you handle this?
defeat_dialogue: Oh gracious! You've bested me!
A lady knows when to concede. Bravo!
You fight with such elegance! I approve!

titles.title: Battle Girl
intro_dialogue: I train every day! My fighting spirit is at MAX!
Bring it on! I love a good challenge!
My animals and I are a perfect team! Let's go!
HYAAAH! Ready for the battle of your life?
I've been doing push-ups all morning! I'm fired up!
mid_battle_dialogue: That's the fire I was looking for!
YEAH! This is what a real battle feels like!
My next fighter is even more intense!
The battle isn't over till the last punch!
COME ON! Give me everything you've got!
defeat_dialogue: WOW! What a battle! You're incredible!
I need to train harder! You really pushed me!
That was AWESOME! Let's do it again!

titles.title: Ace Trainer
intro_dialogue: An Ace Trainer never refuses a challenge! Let's battle!
I've trained under the best. Can you keep up?
My team is perfectly balanced. Show me what you've got!
I didn't earn this title for nothing! Prepare yourself!
Strategy and power — I have both! Ready?
mid_battle_dialogue: Exactly according to plan!
You're skilled, but I've planned for this!
Time for my trump card!
An Ace always has a backup plan!
Impressive! But the real battle starts now!
defeat_dialogue: You're the real ace here. Well played!
I'll take this lesson and come back stronger!
A defeat is just a stepping stone. Until next time!

titles.title: Parasol Lady
intro_dialogue: The weather is perfect for a battle, don't you think?
My animals love rain or shine! Let's have a match!
Don't let the parasol fool you — I'm tough!
A little shade won't stop a great battle!
Oh, how lovely! A challenger on this fine day!
mid_battle_dialogue: The weather may change, but my resolve won't!
My next companion thrives in any condition!
Rain or shine, we battle on!
The breeze carries my determination!
A lady with a parasol is never defenseless!
defeat_dialogue: Oh my! You've defeated me quite thoroughly!
What a refreshing battle! Thank you, dear!
I'll train under the sun and come back stronger!

titles.title: Aroma Lady
intro_dialogue: Can you smell the flowers? My animals love this meadow!
Nature's fragrance empowers my partners! Let's battle!
The aroma of battle is intoxicating, isn't it?
My garden-trained animals are tougher than they look!
Take a deep breath... and prepare for battle!
mid_battle_dialogue: The scent of victory is close!
My next bloom is the most dangerous!
Every petal hides a thorn!
The garden always has more to offer!
The sweet smell of a comeback!
defeat_dialogue: Oh... the petals have fallen. Well battled!
I'll tend my garden and grow stronger!
Your strength is like a mighty oak. I'm impressed!

titles.title: Psychic
intro_dialogue: I knew you would come... The stars told me!
My psychic powers reveal your every move!
The cosmos demands a battle! Who am I to refuse?
Look into my eyes... and see your defeat!
The spirits are restless... They hunger for battle!
mid_battle_dialogue: The astral plane shifts in my favor!
I channeled this outcome long ago!
My next vision shows victory!
The crystal ball never lies!
Cosmic energy flows through my animals!
defeat_dialogue: The stars... they foretold your victory after all.
Even seers can be surprised. Well played!
I must meditate on this defeat...

titles.title: Ranger
intro_dialogue: Rangers defend the wild! Show me you're worthy to pass!
I've bonded with nature itself! My animals are proof!
These trails are under my protection! Battle me!
The wilderness has sharpened my skills! Ready?
My animals and I share a bond forged in nature!
mid_battle_dialogue: Nature provides! My next partner is ready!
The wild always has reinforcements!
Rangers adapt! We're not done yet!
Mother Nature fights beside me!
The forest canopy hides my strength!
defeat_dialogue: You've earned passage. Travel safely!
The wild acknowledges your strength!
A worthy challenger! The forest remembers you!
